newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian statistician may drop monthly BoPs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian statistician may drop monthly BoPs.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics is considering publishing balance of payments data only every quarter, rather than at the present monthly frequency, a spokesman said.
"The proposal is that we will drop a monthly publication of the balance of payments but we would produce a quarterly publication," the spokesman said.
"At this stage it is only a proposal."
The new Liberal-National government has insisted on running cost reductions from all departments and their units, including the bureau.
"Monthly merchandise trade would be retained," said Dennis Trewin, Deputy Australian Statistician.
Although the proposal was not yet firm, it was the bureau's preferred position, he said.
The bureau would now seek the opinions of users before making a final decision.
Bankers Trust Australia senior economist Peter Munckton said the trade data was the most important component of the balance of payments anyway.
"Imports and exports are more or less hard data," he told Reuters.
"The rest are basically projections. Give us the hard data, thank you."
